we provide a framework for stochastic mixed finite element discretizations of fluid-structure interaction problems subject to thermal fluctuations, and demonstrate how to use these discretizations in a practical way.

we develop a stochastic mixed finite element method that is compatible with the fluctuation-dissiation principle, is spatially adaptive, has O ( N ) complexity for generating the driving fields, is applicable to domains with complex geometrics and has been validated with numerical experiments.
